article.title: Pacers and Knicks meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Pacers and Knicks meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: New York Knicks (6-5, fifth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Indiana Pacers (4-8, 11th in the Eastern Conference) Indianapolis; Friday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Knicks -2.5; over/under is 233.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Indiana Pacers face the New York Knicks in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. Indiana went 19-63 overall, 15-37 in Eastern Conference action and 11-30 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pacers averaged 112.4 points per game while allowing opponents to score 120.4 last season. New York went 53-29 overall and 35-17 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Knicks gave up 110.1 points per game while committing 20.0 fouls last season. INJURIES: Pacers: Tyrese Haliburton: out (hamstring), Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl), Aaron Nesmith: day to day (knee). Knicks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
